name: AK32E - Plug-In Indoor Air Quality Monitor (HCHO, CO2, Temperature, Humidity), Electrochemical Formaldehyde Sensor
highlights: Electrochemical Formaldehyde, Permanently Sited — Formaldehyde off-gasses for months after a fit-out, and the release rate rises with heat and humidity. Tracking that curve needs a monitor that stays plugged in and a sensor that does not drift.
The Post-Renovation Configuration — Fit it the day the furniture arrives and leave it until the readings settle — a timescale no handheld instrument is going to cover.
CO₂ Alongside — Ventilation is the remedy for both readings, so both belong on the same screen.
110–240 V — US or EU pins, 25 mm depth.
120 Per Carton — Shared enclosure and packing across the AK32 range.
